news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.29 (down from ₹4.59 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹9.42b (up 31% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.03b (down 6.2% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 11% (down from 15% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 2.8%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 8.1%. Revenue is forecast to grow 16% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 17% growth forecast for the Life Sciences industry in India.

news.title: Now 21% overvalued
news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has fallen 8.5% to ₹514. The fair value is estimated to be ₹426, however this is not to be taken as a sell recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has grown by 12% over the last year. Earnings per share has grown by 14%. Revenue is forecast to grow by 39% in 2 years. Earnings are forecast to grow by 27% in the next 2 years.
